digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / code-review overlays / LLM criterion routing
propositions: T13 plan-review criterion currently triggers only on newly-FORBIDDEN actions (prohibitions) and must be widened to also trigger on newly-ADDED obligations (contracts, invariants, schema fields, required arguments, multi-site synchronization constraints)

Deterministic write-parameter parity checking via a unified contract oracle (library/CLI/MCP adapters) now covers the only demonstrated true-positive class from historical obligation-parity misses, making a new LLM criterion redundant for that family

A content-triggered surface-parity widening to CLI argument changes + NDJSON/import channel would yield ~70% false positives (changes with no MCP/NDJSON obligation) and ~10% true positives, matching the precedent's ~90%-none omitted-scope-site profile, justifying rejection

The deterministic CI import walk (full rebar.* module importlib + scripts/ leg) is approved to replace the proposed LLM import-integrity criterion, per operator ruling that deterministically-measurable defect classes receive deterministic checks

P2 implementation (widening T13 lexicon from prohibition to obligation) requires a second pre-gate alternation branch in det_gate_rules.py carrying additive-obligation phrasings, since the unchanged regex does not match 'callers must', 'must stay in sync', 'new contract', etc.
